title: Append a Log Line
prompt: Append the single line run complete to log.txt (append mode!). The test checks the line exists in the file. Use "a", not "w".

tests.name: log contains the line
tests.code:
with open("log.txt", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _c = _f.read()
assert "run complete" in _c, f"log is {_c!r}"
assert '"a"' in code, "open in append mode"
tests.hint: with open("log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("run complete\n")
